lines.x: Shares in Danish engineering company FLSmidth dropped an additional 1.9% following an 8.9% dive on Monday after the group abruptly dismissed Chief Financial Officer Roland M.
Danish hearing aid manufacturer Demant faces investor scrutiny over whether its operational growth momentum can sustain its 70% share price rally this year.

Berlingske reported that accounts at Danske Bank's former Estonian branch transferred money to Donald Trump prior to the branch being closed over extensive money laundering and financial crime revelations.
Denmark's gross domestic product grew by 0.8% in the third quarter of 2026 compared to the previous quarter, according to Statistics Denmark.
